# Assets · Sources

1 file under `assets/Sources/`, held in the system’s upload store: read one as the file `_blobs/<id>.<ext>` in this system’s directory, the id below as `<id>` (they are not files under that folder — a read by that path fails), then add it to your own work as an asset (`artifact.mjs upload`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for McK_DS_core_Artboards.pdf>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

原始 PDF 是本系统的核对依据。`source-ocr.txt` 保留所提供 Markdown 原文；`source-layout.txt` 是 PDF 的直接文字提取。OCR 文件中的外部图片地址只作为原始记录，预览使用本地保存的 PDF 页图。日期、数值及组件名称按原始版本保留。
